verdict.rationale: Gecko documents an official MCP-style AI-tool integration (docs-9, probe-4) that lets an AI tool list repos/scans, pull vulnerability evidence, triage findings and file tickets, and it posts pass/fail checks to GitHub/GitLab PRs (docs-5) so issues can be caught before merge. However, this is PR/CI-check based rather than a true pre-commit/agent-native hook, and community hands-on reports show notable accuracy problems (false positives at 100% confidence, missed real vulnerabilities) that would undercut trust in feeding results back into an automated agent workflow. missing for 10: dedicated pre-commit/local-agent hook (vs. PR/CI check), independent confirmation of MCP tool accuracy in agentic use, resolution of accuracy complaints from community reports.
